commodity_extras.duplicate_rows_meaning: Count of excess rows flagged by DataFrame.duplicated(subset=duplicate_key); not the size of duplicate groups.
notes: duplicate_rows counts excess rows for key (date, commodity_id).
Extreme price outliers are flagged only; values are retained (markets can gap).
Negative inventory is treated as a data error and nullified during cleaning.
Negative prices are allowed (e.g. historical WTI stress scenarios in synthetic demos).
Time gaps list missing expected-frequency dates; rows are not auto-filled.

disclaimer: Rows with data_type=synthetic / data_source=synthetic_demo are demonstration data only, not live public market feeds.
